camera.reason: 13MP f/1.85 autofocus main camera, no OIS or ultrawide.

performance.reason: Helio G50 with 4GB RAM is usable for calls and social apps but slows under load.

battery.reason: 5,000mAh lasts a full day, but 10W charging is slow to refill.

display.reason: 6.7 inch HD+ LCD at 90Hz with 500 nits.

build.reason: Plastic body with IP54 and a drop resistance certification.

software.reason: Android 14 Go edition with no published OS update commitment.

value.reason: 4GB RAM, IP54 and dual speakers at 23,000 beat the pricier Smart 10 HD.

availability.reason: Out of stock at PriceOye today and not listed on Infinix Pakistan's site; official warranty where sold.
